name: rightmove
description: Multi-server Rightmove monitor with per-server drawn-area searches, filters, safe reconciliation, persistent scheduling, reliable embeds with large property images and Next.js image recovery from Rightmove search-result JSON, price ordering, strict highlighting for permanently discounted outright-ownership homes including LCHO/RSL, cancellable live scrapes, and safe per-server price-limit purging.
author: Five
install_msg: After loading, use `[p]rm setup #anchor <full Rightmove search URL>`. For a profile that should include permanent-discount LCHO/RSL homes hidden by Rightmove’s broad shared-ownership bucket, run `[p]rm affordable on`; genuine shared ownership, shared equity, rent-on-remainder and leasehold listings remain blocked by the cog. Use `[p]rm highlight reset` to mark permanent-discount ownership homes with a star. Use `[p]rm run refresh` to repopulate and rewrite existing large embed images from the current Next.js search payload.
end_user_data_statement: This cog stores per-server configuration, Rightmove property metadata, Discord channel/message IDs, and scrape state. It does not store end-user personal data.
